text.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
text.body_text: - Published A jury in Los Angeles has found a 30-year-old man guilty of starting one of the most destructive wildfires in California's history. Jonathan Rinderknecht was convicted of arson after starting the fires that swept through Pacific Palisades and parts of Malibu in January last year, killing 12 people and destroying more than 6,800 buildings in the US state.…
text.summary: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

text.title: International talks on controlling use of autonomous weapons collapse
text.body_text: Week-long efforts to agree a negotiating mandate for a legally binding international treaty to control on the use of autonomous weapons collapsed just before 5am on Saturday morning, after all night talks failed to overcome Russian objections.…
text.summary: Week-long efforts fail to establish negotiating mandate on AI warfare after Russian ‘filibustering’ Week-long efforts to agree a negotiating mandate for a legally binding international treaty to control on the use of autonomous weapons collapsed just before 5am on Saturday morning, after all night talks failed to overcome Russian objections. Despite an overwhelming majority of states at the Review Conference on Conventional Weapons at the UN in Geneva wanting to agree a negotiating mandate leading to a legally binding treaty, the need for consensus forced the conference to adopt a much weaker option. audio.description: Ragged Dick by . Horatio Alger, Jr. was well known for his best-selling series of books highlighting “the American Dream” of poor boys making good and becoming rich and successful through “luck and pluck”. Ragged Dick was the first in this niche, and follows the adventures of Dick Hunter, a ragged bootblack as he makes the decision to “grow up ’spectable”, and how he goes about achieving his goals
